quality_highlights.aspect: Seven clearly numbered sharing layers with practical code examples and consistent cross-references. Versioning section precisely distinguishes exact tags, moving refs, branch refs, and SHA pins.
Single parameterized error template names exact forbidden field, offers two remediation paths, and links to reference documentation — all in one message.

single_file_improvements.issue: All three status messages have issues: 'Guardian online!' is theatrical; run-success has redundant 'Report delivered! 📋' clause; run-failure reuses 🏛️ success emoji and says 'Structure status unknown...' instead of 'Scan did not complete.'
